title: Llapingachos
description: Llapingachos is a dish from Ecuador featuring potato, queso fresco, chicken egg, green onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 25 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 10 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 16 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
